description: moto g57 power 5G is built for users who want a big battery, smooth display and clean software in one dependable phone. The Snapdragon 6s Gen 4 4 nm processor, paired with 8 GB LPDDR4X RAM and 128 GB UFS 2.2 storage, delivers responsive performance for social apps, browsing, work and casual gaming, while RAM Boost lets you extend memory virtually when you multitask heavily. The 6.72 inch FHD plus LCD with 120 Hz refresh rate keeps scrolling and animations fluid, and high brightness helps the screen stay readable outdoors. A 50 MP Sony LYT 600 main camera and 8 MP ultra wide camera cover detailed shots and wider scenes, supported by moto ai features and Google Photos tools on selected markets to refine portraits and low light photos. An 8 MP front camera with up to 2K video is ready for clear video calls and social content. A large 7000 mAh silicon carbon battery is the highlight, designed to last long days of streaming, calling and navigation, backed by 30 W TurboPower fast charging so you can get back to high battery levels faster.
